text: Adele Fiona Boone, an Electrical Engineer, had an unusual week. The UEBA system flagged her activity due to the "Evidence for triggered rules." Specifically, there were 4 logons outside her typical working hours, a significant increase from her usual 0.50 logons during that time. Additionally, she visited job-search sites 70 times, which is 34 more than her typical 36 visits and well above the 8 visits among her peers in the same role. These events triggered rules R1 and R4, respectively.
